required_contract: Require one valid bucket and bind its exact value into the signed retention target.
Require one valid object key and preserve its exact path encoding before the retention subresource.
Preserve omission or one bounded opaque generation selector in the exact versionId query member.
Preserve omission or sign the sole modeled requester value exactly once.
Preserve omission or sign one bounded control-free owner precondition exactly once.
Preserve absence or decode one exact Retention payload without assigning a default policy.
Preserve absence or decode exactly GOVERNANCE or COMPLIANCE with case-sensitive wire semantics.
Preserve absence or one exact validated ISO-8601 timestamp without normalizing its wire text.
